description: Customer-PO coverage over the source mirror of the Portal reporting API: scan completeness and counts by lineage/status (no values); and REC-01 document carriers: one host capture cycle (operating.host: the Portal sales orders, the PLXCUSTOMERS 'Customer Documents' folder through the GET-only Graph reader), then operating.customer_po_coverage.document_carriers over the projection as the same principals: per record kind a document class attests, how many values a captured document states that Portal holds empty (missing_in_portal) or differently (conflict, document_blank). Counts and schema names only, never a value, key or citation.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; the module test is injected-transport (operating/tests/test_customer_po_coverage_live.py DocumentCarrierLiveCheckTests: the spec's own command, its host config copied with the in-process FakeWorkbench and a FakeDrive standing for the PLXCUSTOMERS site; its expectations checked on the real output). document_carriers.by_status all zero means no captured document stated a value an order the reader sees lacks or contradicts (or no document was linked), never a pass of REC-01 by itself; records_checked says how many orders were compared.
